question_pt: Qual o valor total de internacoes por estado de residencia MA e RS?
sql: SELECT m."SG_UF" AS uf_residencia, ROUND(SUM(i."VAL_TOT"), 2) AS valor_total FROM internacoes i LEFT JOIN municipios m ON i."MUNIC_RES" = m."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" WHERE m."SG_UF" IN ('MA', 'RS') GROUP BY m."SG_UF" ORDER BY m."SG_UF"
